name: Agent Readiness Doctor
description: Finds and fixes stale or unsafe agent instructions with review
about: Checks AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor and Copilot rules, and agent settings against the actual repository. It uses agent-context-doctor and agent-readiness-kit when installed, confirms each finding in the code, and proposes minimal fixes. It edits only what you approve, then re-runs the checks.
features: Catch missing scripts, moved files and contradictions
Flag unsafe directives and risky agent permissions
Apply approved fixes and re-run the audits
examplePrompt: Check this repo's AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md for stale commands, broken links and unsafe advice, and propose fixes.
